descriptions.text: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Leprous Bandit. This is a unique item. Most children in the universe know the exciting tale of the Leprous Bandit, the infamous human thief whose people were starving to death because of a planet-wide quarantine. … To this day, the Leprous Bandit remains an inspiration. This toe ring imbues the following: The Sticky Feet Benefit. The Super Spreader Benefit.

beats.headline: Smushed for Daddy
beats.text: Being stepped upon by a deity and surviving earns Carl the Smushed for Daddy achievement and a platinum Spicy Box, which he got, as he puts it, because the system AI is a goddamned pervert. Inside is a toe ring with a long tale of a human thief who broke into a floating garden. Two benefits in one item, says Mordecai; that is almost legendary tier. Sticky Feet: once every six hours, for his dexterity times two seconds, Carl may walk on a wall or ceiling, bare feet only. Super Spreader passes his active debuffs to a target once an hour. Gross, he says, and slides it onto his left pinky.

beats.headline: Upside down over an ooze
beats.text: They go with Carl's least favorite idea, the last resort, which Donut suggests out loud: he will walk on the ceiling over the ooze. Sticky Feet gives him his dexterity times two seconds, once every six hours, and his dexterity sits at thirty-two. He has practised a few times, but not yet in combat. Oozes hunt by vibration and sound, Mordecai warns, so his clomping on the ceiling will draw it unless he distracts it with one of the things he built. He lowers himself, places a bare foot on the ceiling, and readies Sticky Feet.

beats.headline: Stuck to the wing
beats.text: Carl is clutching the wing brace when the plane pulls sharply upward and whips around like a haywire carnival ride. He activates Sticky Feet at once, which for a moment saves him from flying right off the wing. Donut is in the cockpit, screaming, all the way on her back against the small seat with a death grip on the yoke. The plane does a complete loop, and loops again, rolling starboard.

beats.headline: Left to Fester, shared
beats.text: Carl has used Sticky Feet a lot; the ring's second ability he has never tried. Super Spreader reaches anyone close enough for him to see their name, and Ping has made that range far greater. He scrolls the list to Hunter Xindy, a level 61 mantis of the Dark Hive, and clicks Activate. She stops dead in the air, then retreats fast as she realises she has a debuff: she now has his Left to Fester too, and it will not go away until Chin'Dua is dead.

beats.headline: Quan Ch, leaking slugs
beats.text: Quan Ch has both sets of keys and is heading for one of the two exits. Carl makes a new chat group for Imani and Tserendolgor. Be careful: he is really good, but he is not going to be feeling well. Carl cast Super Spreader on him at the last second, and he is going to be leaking slugs. They will fight for him, but every one that comes out damages him more, and it gets worse with each passing minute. Delay him as long as possible.
